entities.summary: Sara Jane Ho is a Chinese businessman, writer, educator, socialite, and founder of Institute Sarita, a Beijing finishing school established in 2013. She is the etiquette expert and host for the 2022 Netflix series Mind Your Manners. The New York Times has described her as a representation of the new "Superrich" in China.
